snippet.title: The Last Disease Z - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Survive in a dangerous open world overrun by zombies, where every decision matters.

Explore abandoned towns, gather resources, build and expand your base, fish, craft essential gear, and fight both the infected and other survivors. Whether you're scavenging for supplies or defending your home, every day is a new challenge.

Features:

🧟 Fight hordes of zombies and dangerous bosses
🌲 Gather resources and loot abandoned locations
🏠 Build and upgrade your own base
🎣 Fish, craft, and survive
🌍 Explore a handcrafted open world
⚔️ Face unpredictable PvE and PvP encounters

The Last Disease Z is an indie open-world zombie survival game inspired by the freedom and tension of classic survival experiences while introducing its own unique mechanics.

👉 Wishlist on Steam and follow development to stay updated!
